description: A single banquette with sprung seat, eight stitched ribs, wrapped end caps and a recessed foot plinth.
Rounded laminate and chromed edge, porcelain cups, plates and a wire condiment caddy.
Pedestal stool with a round vinyl seat, tubular foot ring, bearings and a chromed skirt.
Folded steel coin newspaper box with a sloping cap, paper window, lever, latch and welded feet.
Two timber LP bins containing individual printed sleeves, divider tabs, etched vinyl discs and a sloped browsing lip.
Two tilted coastal photovoltaic modules with visible cell lattice, raised south legs, cable and inverter.
